summary: Translate a clearly stated neural model into runnable, unit-aware simulations and reproducible outputs.
outcomes: Implement and inspect a small neural simulation in an appropriate framework.
Distinguish model equations, numerical solver and software implementation.
sequence: State a model and prediction before coding
Map variables, units and connections to a simulator
Run and inspect a minimal single-neuron case
Compare conceptual roles of Brian2 and Nengo
Pin environments and verify reproducibility and convergence

visual.question: Which piece of code implements each modeling assumption?
visual.interaction: Select a variable or connection to highlight its equation, implementation and recorded effect.

practice.task: Build a small simulated circuit and reproduce one expected response.
practice.success: Includes units, environment versions, solver checks and an interpretation beyond a screenshot.
